title: Trump shooting live: Uk’s Starmer ‘shocked’ by shooting at Trump media dinner
summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer said Sunday he was "shocked" by a shooting at the annual dinner of the White House Correspondents' Association. US President Donald Trump was unharmed and other top White House officials were evacuated after a man armed with guns and knives stormed the lobby and opened fire. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
